title: (No AI) I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
author: Sean Hollister
content:
![A silver pendant touchscreen computer with a cute little tamagotchi like mascot on screen.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/verge-sean-hollister-muse-gadget-331A2564-01-3.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=4,0,96,94.899920311255)

Mark Zuckerberg's Meta [made AI look so stinking cute](https://www.theverge.com/column/999999/optimizer-meta-muse-ai-cute) by giving it a squishy little face - and this holiday season, he wants to sell you [a Muse Charm](https://www.theverge.com/tech/999750/muse-charm-meta-ai-hardware) so you can carry your jolly AI helper around like a Tamagotchi.

But I won't be buying one, because _we have Muse Charm at home_. It cost just $50, and I've decided the learning experience was worth it.

[View Link](https://www.tiktok.com/@verge/video/7702862550014168333)

My version doesn't [sport cameras or a 5G cellular radio](https://www.theverge.com/tech/999944/meta-muse-charm-ai-interact-5g-modem), but it really talks to Muse and has cute avatars, too! It doubles as a pocket watch and a remote camera viewfinder, and it can (theoretically) control my smart home.

Or at least it can if you inject a lot of extra vibe code.

Weeks …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/1013375/muse-charm-gadgets-preview-waveshare-esp32-claude-vibe-code)

title: (No AI) Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
author: Jay Peters
content:
![Image of iPhone 16 running iOS 18.1 with Apple Intelligence on a bench.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25699392/DSC08596_processed.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced [on its Chinese newsroom website](https://www.apple.com.cn/newsroom/2026/10/apple-intelligence-features-are-coming-to-users-in-china/), as [reported by _MacRumors_](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/10/30/apple-says-ios-27-3-beta-coming-next-week/). The Apple Intelligence features will be available first in an iOS 27.3 beta that's set to launch on November 4th, with a full iOS 27.3 release scheduled for December.

This launch doesn't bring the new Siri AI to China. Instead, Apple is launching several of its earlier Apple Intelligence features like notification summaries, real-time translation, rewriting and proofreading tools, visual intelligence, and removing objects from photos. Apple also says it has worked with Ailbaba to add support for its Q …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1023974/apple-intelligence-china-ios-27-3)
